title: Capacity changes batch count
hook: Twenty objects and a six-object carrier: a remainder still needs another trip.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Calculate whole batch counts using a stated usable capacity.

misconception: A fractional last batch can be ignored when counting trips.
objective: Calculate whole batch counts using a stated usable capacity.

claims.text: Ideal carriers hold exactly six or eight identical objects. Objects cannot be split; capacity is assumed usable. Scaled model; ideal usable capacities; no weight or safety claim.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Objects=20, A=4batches and B=3batches. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["ceil",["/","x",6]]; B=["ceil",["/","x",8]]; x denotes Objects. At x=20, A=4, B=3; recall at x=23: B=3. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: Divide object count by usable capacity and round up. The partial final batch still counts as a complete trip in this quantity-only model. Volume, weight and safe carrying limits would require separate constraints.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. claims.text: Ideal carriers hold exactly six or eight identical objects. Objects cannot be split; capacity is assumed usable. Change only Objects to 23. What is B (Eight-capacity) now? Correct: 3batches. Use B's stated rule with Objects=23: it gives 3batches. Divide object count by usable capacity and round up. The partial final batch still counts as a complete trip in this quantity-only model. Volume, weight and safe carrying limits would require separate constraints.

recall.question: Ideal carriers hold exactly six or eight identical objects. Objects cannot be split; capacity is assumed usable. Change only Objects to 23. What is B (Eight-capacity) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Objects=23: it gives 3batches. Divide object count by usable capacity and round up. The partial final batch still counts as a complete trip in this quantity-only model. Volume, weight and safe carrying limits would require separate constraints.

safety.assumptions: Ideal carriers hold exactly six or eight identical objects. Objects cannot be split; capacity is assumed usable.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
